apps.close: Close the active app, back to home.
apps.install: usbos.apps.install(vpath) — reads a .uapp from any readable VFS path (e.g. 'shared:app.uapp') and runs the normal flow (validation, on-screen consent, revertible write).
apps.list: List installed apps with their manifest.
apps.open: usbos.apps.open(id) — open an app (like a click in the sidebar).
apps.reload: usbos.apps.reload(id) — reload an app (close then reopen).

dev.dumpState: Snapshot of non-sensitive info useful for a bug report (never the passphrase/key).

fs.cat: usbos.fs.cat(vpath) — read a text file. data: paths are decrypted if the session is unlocked, otherwise raw reading is refused.
fs.rm: usbos.fs.rm(vpath, { confirm: true }) — delete a file. Destructive.
fs.stat: usbos.fs.stat(vpath) — whether it exists or not.
fs.write: usbos.fs.write(vpath, content, force, { confirm: true }) — write a text file (created if missing). Destructive. For system:*, config:update-sources.json: force must be true in addition to confirm.
fs.writeProtected: Write refused on {path} (protected system file/folder). Add force=true if this is intentional.

console.guardedConfirm: Destructive action — call again with { confirm: true } as last argument to confirm.

help.header:
Short forms: u.<category>.<command>() (e.g. u.logs.tail(100)),
and read-only getters without parens: u.info u.apps u.tail
u.errors u.uptime u.version u.status u.updates u.help.
DevTools autocompletes natively after u. (no grey ghost there).
help.palette: Show this help in the palette.

logs.clear: Clear the in-memory log (deletes nothing on disk).
logs.export: Write the full log to system:logs/usbos-<date>.log on the key.
logs.filter: usbos.logs.filter({level, source, contains}) — filter the log.

mesh.note: Mesh state lives in the app iframe (isolated) — open it via usbos.apps.open('mesh') then use its UI. No direct access from here (sandbox).

palette.confirmDestructive: “{path}” is destructive — Enter to confirm, Esc or any other key to cancel.
palette.hint: TAB complete · ↑↓ navigate/history · Enter run · Esc close
palette.pendingHint: “{path}” is destructive — Enter to confirm, Esc or any other key to cancel.
palette.placeholder: Type a command… (e.g. tail, apps open notes)

security.changePassphrase: usbos.security.changePassphrase('old', 'new', { confirm: true }) — change the passphrase (re-encrypt everything, full backup + auto-resume). Destructive.
security.lock: Lock the session (wipe the master key from memory, reload the page).
security.removePassphrase: usbos.security.removePassphrase('my-phrase', { confirm: true }) — remove the passphrase (everything back to plaintext, with backup + auto-resume). Irreversible without re-encrypting. Destructive.
security.setPassphrase: usbos.security.setPassphrase('my-phrase', { confirm: true }) — encrypt a plaintext key (migration with auto backup). The phrase stays in console history: local session only. Destructive.

system.lang: usbos.system.lang() — list languages; usbos.system.lang('en') — switch language (repaints + reopens the app).
system.settings: Open the Settings page (theme, security, sharing, system).
system.theme: usbos.system.theme() | theme('light') | theme('dark','violet') — read or change the theme (dark|light|auto) and accent (blue|violet|vert|orange).

updater.apply: usbos.updater.apply({ confirm: true }) — apply the last check. Destructive (rewrites system files).
updater.check: Check available updates (does not apply them, returns the plan).

apps.builtinReserved: “{id}” is a reserved id (built-in app, or already managed by updates) — a .uapp package can't replace it.
apps.busy: An install is already in progress.

consent.access: What this app will be able to do
consent.accessData: Read/write its own data, encrypted like everything else (data:).
consent.accessShared: Read/write the Shared folder (unencrypted, common to every app).
consent.downgrade: Warning: the package's version is OLDER than the one installed.
consent.hashHint: SHA-256 of the whole package — note it down if you ever need to verify where it came from.
consent.netHosts: Connect to the network, only to: {hosts}.
consent.replaceCheck: I understand the existing app's code will be replaced.
consent.replaceWarn: An app named “{name}” already exists (version {from}). Replacing it overwrites its code — its data (under data:) is kept.
consent.warn: USBos does not sign or verify where .uapp packages come from: only install ones you built yourself or got from a source you trust.

apps.guestBlocked: Installing an app isn't allowed in guest mode.
apps.unavailable: The .uapp package reader is unavailable (system/uapp.js missing).

boot.incompleteBody: A system file is missing (vfs/crypto/logbus/updater). Reinstall USBos via installer.html without touching data/.

connect.body: Select the USBos folder (if it already exists) or its parent folder (for a fresh install).
connect.directWarnBody: Without the parent folder, the Shared/ space stays unavailable:
connect.directWarnList1: Guest access from the lock screen unavailable
connect.directWarnList5: Settings will show Shared/ as Inactive
connect.guestHint: Not the owner? Access shared files with no password:
connect.title: Power on USBos

dash.coffreLocked: Vault present — contents locked by its own passphrase.
dash.meshEmpty: Open Mesh to generate the code.
dash.migrate: Data needs migration — open the Calendar.

errors.alreadyEncrypted: Session already encrypted — nothing to migrate.
errors.binTooBig: Binary too large (max 256 MB per write).
errors.guestDenied: Action not allowed in guest session.
errors.locked: Locked session — unlock USBos before this command.
errors.needChange: Session not encrypted — nothing to change.
errors.notEncrypted: Session not encrypted — nothing to remove.
errors.plainOnly: Migration is for plaintext keys only (start without passphrase).
errors.rpcFileTooBig: File too large for text reading.
errors.rpcJsonTooBig: File too large for JSON reading.
errors.samePass: The new passphrase must differ from the old one.

guest.heroHint: Shared key files — neither your apps nor your private data are visible here.
guest.pickParent: For guest mode, choose the parent folder (containing USBos/).
guest.previewTooBig: No preview over 100 MB — download the file instead.

journal.btnTitle: Print the log to the DevTools console (F12)
journal.sentToast: Log sent to the console — open DevTools (F12 → Console tab).

lang.reopenWarn: Language applied — reopen the current app (unsaved draft lost).

settings.accentDetail: Color of buttons, links and highlights.
settings.appInstallDetail: From a .uapp package (renamed ZIP) — validated, then confirmed before anything is written.
settings.countsDetail: Counts of notes, documents, events and shared files.
settings.customEmpty: No custom theme — create or import one.
settings.hint: All customization lives here. Applied immediately, including in the open app.
settings.imgDetail: JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF, 8 MB max, 10 max. Plaintext in config:wallpaper-slides/.
settings.keysHint: Keyboard: these shortcuts work across USBos.
settings.langDetail: French, English or imported pack. Applied everywhere.
settings.langEmpty: No custom language — import a pack.
settings.secAddDetail: Encrypts existing data/ (auto backup). Local input only.
settings.secChangeDetail: Re-encrypts all of data/ (verified first, full backup + auto-resume).
settings.secLockedInfoDetail: Full lock requires reloading the page.
settings.secModeDetail: All of data/ is encrypted, or readable in plaintext.
settings.secNeedMatch: The two new ones do not match.
settings.secNeedUnlocked: Unlock the key to manage security.
settings.secReloadPlain: Reload the page to continue unprotected.
settings.secRemoveDetail: Everything goes plaintext (verified first, backup + auto-resume).
settings.shareActive: Active — plaintext by design, readable outside USBos.
settings.shareInactive: Inactive — reconnect via the parent folder.
settings.srcDetail: Preset gradients or your imported images.
settings.sysGuideDetail: Full documentation, source code, and bug reports.
settings.sysUpdateDetail: Checks via GitHub raw (delta, staging then switch).
settings.themeDetail: Dark, light or system-following. Applied everywhere, no reload.
settings.title: ⚙️ Settings
settings.wallDetail: Lock + desktop (+ opt-in apps). Slides = preset rotation.

setup.body: This passphrase encrypts ALL your data (notes, calendar, documents…) — not just the Vault. It is never written to disk: without it, your data is unreadable.
setup.skipNeedCheck: Check the box to continue unprotected.
setup.skipWarn: I understand my data will be stored IN PLAINTEXT on the key, readable by anyone who plugs it in.
setup.title: Protect this key

unsupported.body: USBos requires the File System Access API (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi).
unsupported.title: Unsupported browser
